name: open_screen
description: Take the shopper to a screen in the app: home, chat, orders, calls (their booked delivery calls), memory (what you remember about them) or profile. Use it instead of describing where to tap.

name: open_item
description: Open one of the shopper's orders so they can see its delivery details. Name the order by its product or its order number.

item.description: The product or the order number, e.g. "Running shoes, size 7" or "GD-55120".

name: request_return
description: Start a return for a delivered order, when the shopper asks to return it and it is still within its return date. Confirm which order first.

item.description: The product or the order number, e.g. "Yoga mat, 6 mm" or "GD-54702".

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an order that has not been delivered yet, when the shopper asks to cancel it. Confirm which order first.

item.description: The product or the order number, e.g. "Wireless earbuds" or "GD-55302".
